grammar.pattern: 为 + 受益者 + 动作
grammar.explanation: 为朋友打印 identifies the beneficiary. 给朋友两页材料 identifies the recipient in a transfer; the patterns can describe different aspects of the same event. 为 wèi here is not wéi in 成为. A beneficiary phrase does not prove that permission has been obtained. Ask first when the action affects another person’s records.

examples.py: wǒ wèi péng you dǎ yìn cái liào .
examples.en: I print materials for my friend.

examples.zh: 先为她问清楚，再给她答复。
examples.py: xiān wèi tā wèn qīng chǔ , zài gěi tā dá fù .
examples.en: First clarify for her, then give her a reply.

examples.py: wǒ bù néng tì tā tóng yì .
examples.en: I cannot agree on her behalf.

commonMistakes.wrong: 我为她同意参加，所以她一定愿意。
commonMistakes.right: 先取得她的同意，再帮她报名。
commonMistakes.why: An action for someone is not evidence of their consent.

grammar.pattern: 有 + 意思 / 用 / 时间等：评价或条件
grammar.purpose: Read 有 in a stated evaluation
grammar.explanation: 这份材料有用 evaluates usefulness, rather than saying the material owns a physical object called 用. 很有意思 evaluates interest. 我有时间 remains an availability statement. Identify the whole phrase; possession and evaluation are separate uses, and usefulness depends on the stated task.

examples.py: zhè liǎng yè cái liào hěn yǒu yòng .
zhè gè lì zi hěn yǒu yì si .
wǒ xià wǔ yǒu shí jiān bāng nǐ .
examples.en: I have time to help you this afternoon.

commonMistakes.wrong: 这材料是有用的东西有。
commonMistakes.why: Use 有用 as the evaluation predicate.

dialogue.title: Two pages, after permission
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
dialogue.purpose: Find the exact favour and what must happen first.

lines.zh: 你下午有时间吗？能为我打印材料吗？
lines.py: nǐ xià wǔ yǒu shí jiān ma ? néng wèi wǒ dǎ yìn cái liào ma ?
lines.en: Do you have time this afternoon? Can you print materials for me?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 可以，哪几页？
lines.py: kě yǐ , nǎ jǐ yè ?
lines.en: Yes; which pages?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 第二页和第三页，两页就够。
lines.py: dì èr yè hé dì sān yè , liǎng yè jiù gòu .
lines.en: Pages two and three; two pages are enough.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好。办公室几点开？
lines.py: hǎo . bàn gōng shì jǐ diǎn kāi ?
lines.en: Okay. When does the office open?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 下午两点，计算机和打印机都可以用。
lines.py: xià wǔ liǎng diǎn , jì suàn jī hé dǎ yìn jī dōu kě yǐ yòng .
lines.en: At two in the afternoon; the computer and printer are available.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 那我两点去取，拿到以后给你。
lines.py: nà wǒ liǎng diǎn qù qǔ , ná dào yǐ hòu gěi nǐ .
lines.en: Then I will collect them at two and give them to you once I have them.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 活动也帮我报名吧。
lines.py: huó dòng yě bāng wǒ bào míng ba .
lines.en: Please sign me up for the activity too.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 先取得你的同意：是星期六的活动吗？
lines.py: xiān qǔ dé nǐ de tóng yì : shì xīng qī liù de huó dòng ma ?
lines.en: First let me get your consent: do you mean Saturday’s activity?
lines.speaker: b

choices: No, consent and the activity are still being clarified
Yes, the last line confirms completion
questions.answer: No, consent and the activity are still being clarified

lines.zh: 今天我为朋友打印两页教学材料。
lines.py: jīn tiān wǒ wèi péng you dǎ yìn liǎng yè jiào xué cái liào .

lines.py: dì èr yè hé dì sān yè hěn yǒu yòng , bù yòng dǎ yìn zhěng běn shū .
lines.en: Pages two and three are useful; there is no need to print the whole book.

lines.zh: 办公室下午两点开，里面有计算机。
lines.py: bàn gōng shì xià wǔ liǎng diǎn kāi , lǐ miàn yǒu jì suàn jī .
lines.en: The office opens at two in the afternoon and contains a computer.

lines.py: jiào shì hái zài shàng kè , bù qù nà lǐ qǔ .
lines.en: Class is still in progress in the classroom; do not collect the materials there.

lines.zh: 拿到材料以后，检查页数，再给朋友。
lines.py: ná dào cái liào yǐ hòu , jiǎn chá yè shù , zài gěi péng you .
lines.en: After receiving the materials, check the page count and give them to the friend.

lines.zh: 打印是自愿帮助，不是代替朋友同意参加。
lines.py: dǎ yìn shì zì yuàn bāng zhù , bù shì dài tì péng you tóng yì cān jiā .
lines.en: Printing is voluntary help, not consent to participate on the friend’s behalf.

lines.zh: 活动的时间和责任都要讲清楚。
lines.py: huó dòng de shí jiān hé zé rèn dōu yào jiǎng qīng chǔ .
lines.en: The activity’s time and responsibilities must be explained clearly.

lines.zh: 取得同意以后才能报名，校长也还没有答应计划。
lines.py: qǔ dé tóng yì yǐ hòu cái néng bào míng , xiào zhǎng yě hái méi yǒu dā yìng jì huà .
lines.en: Register only after obtaining consent; the principal has not agreed to the plan either.

choices: Clarify the task and obtain consent
Assume every request is complete permission
